eplb_moe_placement.description: MoE expert-parallel load balancing: reduce rebalance work while preserving GPU load balance.

work_efficiency_vs_greedy.description: Candidate balance-adjusted operation-count efficiency relative to the public greedy DeepSeek-style baseline; reported for context but not scored.

work_efficiency_vs_frontier_reference.description: Primary machine-independent operation-count efficiency against the frontier-reference-style zigzag baseline, adjusted by measured GPU load balance on the scored slice.

mean_imbalance_factor.description: Mean GPU load balance ratio across traces; preserves the paper's no-worse-load-balance constraint.

valid_fraction.description: Fraction of slice traces with structurally valid placement artifacts.

reported_runtime_ms.description: Paper-reported wall-clock runtime kept only to validate legacy reference-result keys; not emitted by split evaluators and not scored.

mean_operation_count.description: Mean machine-independent rebalance work; penalizes improvements that only win by increasing counted work.

num_traces.description: Number of traces scored in this slice; emitted for auditability and not scored.

complete_fraction.description: Fraction of required slice traces for which the method emitted a placement artifact; catches methods that skip difficult traces.

family_imbalance_floor.description: Worst family-level mean load balance; catches methods tuned to one workload family while regressing on another.

family_imbalance_spread.description: Gap between best and worst family-level mean load balance; penalizes uneven behavior across workload families.

high_skew_mean_imbalance_factor.description: Mean load balance on the higher-skew half of the slice; catches methods that only handle easy load distributions.

high_skew_mean_operation_count.description: Mean counted rebalance work on higher-skew traces; catches hidden work blowups on difficult load distributions.

min_imbalance_factor.description: Worst per-trace GPU load balance ratio on the slice; catches methods that keep the mean balanced while sacrificing hard cases.

p95_operation_count.description: High-percentile rebalance work across traces; catches methods that hide rare expensive placements behind a good mean.
